sources.title: Silicon dioxide coating boosts PV module light transmission, thermal performance
sources.excerpt:
An international research team developed a porous silicon dioxide coating for PV cover glass that combines anti-reflection with passive radiative cooling, increasing solar transmittance while enhancing mid-infrared emissivity. sources.excerpt:
